scenarios.name: spawn-table
scenarios.purpose: Spawn period table: 1/2/3 lines x L=1/10/30/64; first departures at ceil(period/1000) ticks; E-SPAWN 18461/24000/20869 mt.

scenarios.name: growth
scenarios.purpose: Growth timers: L=1 fires at 64600 mt (tick 65), L=63 fires at 45560 mt (tick 46); no line, no growth debt.

scenarios.name: capture-exact-no-flip
scenarios.purpose: One soldier on a level-1 neutral: level hits 0 but ownership does not flip (exact L).

scenarios.name: capture-flip-overshoot
scenarios.purpose: L+1 soldiers flip a level-1 neutral; the flipped building starts at level 0 (overshoot discarded).

scenarios.name: capture-kills-troops
scenarios.purpose: Capture kills every troop sourced at the captured building: on its drawn line and on a line it cut earlier.

scenarios.name: exchange-soldier-vs-tank
scenarios.purpose: Head-on exchange: soldier dies, tank hp 2 -> 1; the damaged tank trades with the next soldier.

scenarios.name: exchange-tank-vs-tank
scenarios.purpose: Head-on tank vs tank (attack 2, hp 2): both die in one round.

scenarios.name: reverse-replace
scenarios.purpose: Drawing the reverse of an own line replaces it (cut reason replaced); in-flight troops keep flying.

scenarios.name: no-auto-cut-level-drop
scenarios.purpose: A hit drops stage 2 -> 1: both lines stay (free < 0), a new draw is rejected no-slot.

scenarios.name: overflow-forward
scenarios.purpose: Friendly arrival above max level: forwarded on a seeded drawn line (cause forward); no line = surplus lost.

scenarios.name: alive-cap-skip
scenarios.purpose: Alive cap 30: a due spawn is skipped (timer still consumed) once 30 troops are alive.

scenarios.name: win-ignored-flip
scenarios.purpose: Win when the human owns every non-ignored building; ignored buildings flip to the winner.

scenarios.name: loss
scenarios.purpose: Loss when the human owns no non-ignored building (an ignored one does not save it); winner null.

scenarios.name: timeout
scenarios.purpose: Time limit 3 s = 60 ticks with no decisive result: timeout, winner null.

scenarios.name: rejections
scenarios.purpose: Every draw/cut reject reason reachable in SP03: self, duplicate, no-slot, not-owner, unknown-id, malformed, not-drawer, no-line.
